notes: Corner of a brick building in Punavuori, Helsinki, steep angle. Two street signs: the old enamel plates 'TELAKKAKATU / DOCKSGATAN' at left (target, per the file categories) and a modern white plate 'MUNKKISAARENKATU / MUNKHOLMSGATAN' higher up, which is equally valid. A tiny worn third plate '...HOLMSG...' and a fire-hydrant 'T' marker are distractors. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Xepheid
attribution: Photo: Xepheid, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Central_hospital_of_Lapland_20200625.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Blue free-standing name board of the Central Hospital of Lapland, Rovaniemi, with the Northern Sami name on the third line. At 1600 px no diacritics are visible on the Sami line (expected Northern Sami spelling would use á/š), so it is transcribed as seen. Small parking signs behind are distractors. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_categories: Bilingual Finnish-Northern Sami signs in Finland
